title: GET /reports – 200 response
description: The report archive of the caller's sites, newest period first (ties by id); ?site_id= limits it to one site, ?type= to one kind of report. At most 100 reports per page; with next_cursor not null, request the next page with ?cursor=<next_cursor> (and the same filters). Supervisor token only. Error responses use api/error.json.
